id: go-islo-workdir-not-contained-under-workspace
title: Islo workdir joined or passed through without containing it under /workspace
summary: The configured Islo workdir is turned into a sandbox path without validation. An absolute value
  is returned as-is, a relative value is joined to /workspace without rejecting `..` segments, and the
  raw value is passed to sandbox creation. A malicious or misconfigured workdir can escape /workspace,
  so later `rm -rf`, `mkdir -p` and `tar -C` commands run against arbitrary sandbox paths.
cwe:
- CWE-22
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- go
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 6b07193fb5670aac315ea47215651c67b8127868
  vulnerable_ref: 6b07193fb5670aac315ea47215651c67b8127868^
  patched_ref: 6b07193fb5670aac315ea47215651c67b8127868
  repository: https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox
rule:
  message: 'Workdir-derived path is built from configuration without enforcing containment under /workspace.
    Reject absolute paths, clean the value, and reject ".", ".." and "../" prefixes before joining it
    to /workspace or sending it to the Islo API.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: return path.Join("/workspace", $W)
    - pattern: "if strings.HasPrefix($W, \"/\") {\n    return path.Clean($W)\n}\n"
    - pattern: $C.Workdir = stringValue($CFG.Islo.Workdir)
  - pattern-not-inside: "func $F(...) $R {\n    ...\n    strings.HasPrefix($X, \"../\")\n    ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Resolve the workdir through one helper that trims it, rejects absolute paths, runs path.Clean,
    and rejects ".", ".." and any "../" prefix, returning an error. Build the workspace path with path.Join("/workspace",
    relative) from the validated value. Use the same validated relative value when setting the workdir
    on sandbox creation, and fail early in Run and createSandbox if validation fails.
  example: "func isloRelativeWorkdir(cfg Config) (string, error) {\n    workdir := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Islo.Workdir)\n\
    \    if workdir == \"\" {\n        workdir = \"crabbox\"\n    }\n    if strings.HasPrefix(workdir,\
    \ \"/\") {\n        return \"\", exit(2, \"islo workdir %q must be relative under /workspace\", workdir)\n\
    \    }\n    workdir = path.Clean(workdir)\n    if workdir == \".\" || workdir == \"..\" || strings.HasPrefix(workdir,\
    \ \"../\") {\n        return \"\", exit(2, \"islo workdir %q escapes /workspace\", workdir)\n    }\n\
    \    return workdir, nil\n}\n"
